name: aversion to strangers
quote: I don't usually hold with foreign food.
description: Anxiety about people who are unfamiliar or have different customs or language.

variations.name: stranger danger
variations.description: Being distrustful of unknown people in general, no matter what type.

variations.name: cultural wariness
variations.description: Being uncomfortable with people who's looks, language, or customs are different than what you're familiar with.

variations.name: cultural chauvinism
variations.description: Discomfort and distain when interacting with people who's looks, language, or customs are different than what you're familiar with.

commentaries.quote: Some people thrive in a multicultural environment, enjoying frequent new experiences. Some do not, preferring familiar things.

I was a picky eater as a teen. I wanted to control this one aspect of my life and liked being an expert on hamburgers. I didn't want to look ignorant by not knowing about weird foods like 'falafels' and 'paneer'. It does take a while to become attuned to all that stuff. But life is long, and I'm glad I did.

conditions: You experience anxiety when confronted with an unfamiliar social experience.
